label: CXO
claim: However, its headline **Sharpe above 1.5 and 10.8% alpha versus BTC** is for a rotational top-20 altcoin book that uses up to 200% leverage, which this account cannot use ([CXO]).

label: SSRN
claim: An SSRN preprint titled "Time-series Momentum in Cryptocurrency: A Published Edge that has Aged" points the other way, but its numbers could not be verified ([SSRN]).

label: ACFR
claim: The authors themselves flag in-sample parameter selection and call ~1.5 an optimistic maximum ([ACFR]).

label: Man Group
claim: Man Group found that scaling BTC to a 30% volatility target from 2012 to 2024 raised Sharpe by **"around 40 Sharpe points"** whatever half-life was used, and improved expected shortfall ([Man Group]).

label: Äijö et al. 2025
claim: Academic vol-managed crypto *momentum* raised payoffs but **did not change the tail exponent** ([Äijö et al. 2025]).

label: NBER w25882
claim: Their own caveat is that the results ignore "trading costs and the feasibility of short selling." When BTC replaces the short leg, most momentum strategies lose significance ([NBER w25882]).

label: Fieberg, Liedtke & Zaremba, IRFA 2024
claim: Size and volume anomalies **"originate from micro-cap coins of negligible economic importance,"** momentum alpha comes "largely from short positions," and anomaly returns cluster in bull markets and weaken over time ([Fieberg, Liedtke & Zaremba, IRFA 2024]).

label: Äijö et al. 2025
claim: Value-weighted across ~2,500 coins it was significantly negative at −3.40% a week, and a single coin's jump produced a −255% week ([Äijö et al. 2025]).

label: Ammann et al. 2022
claim: That bias runs at **62% a year for equal-weighted portfolios versus 0.93% for value-weighted ones** ([Ammann et al. 2022]).

label: K33
claim: The altcoin book ended near **$7,000 against $50,000 for BTC**, and about 700 of 1,009 entrants ended inactive or worthless ([K33]).

label: Quantpedia
claim: So does the failure of top-gainer pullback dip-buying, which is consistent with two further findings: buying new N-day lows decayed out-of-sample after 2022 ([Quantpedia]), and crypto momentum flips to reversal at roughly 4–6 weeks, especially in small coins ([HSE/Dobrynskaya]).

label: HSE/Dobrynskaya

label: Falkenstein
claim: It is insignificant in Liu et al., and its support is a non-peer-reviewed 2018–2024 blog result ([Falkenstein]).

label: INFORMS
claim: The MVRV-style "value" factor of Cong et al. is promising, but its magnitudes were not verifiable ([INFORMS]).

label: Kitron & Wengrowicz 2026
